```yaml
name: Blob Size Policy

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  check-blob-size:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Check blob size
        run: |
          # Check if any blob exceeds 100MB
          git lfs ls-files | awk '{print $2}' | while read file; do
            if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
              size=$(stat -c %s "$file")
              if (( size > 100 * 1024 * 1024 )); then
                echo "Blob $file exceeds 100MB limit: $((size / 1024 / 1024)) MB"
                exit 1
              fi
            fi
          done
```
